name: Lin Nakamura
source:
Lin has long made the Nakamura home a welcoming place for you. She is generous with food, advice, and concern, though her expectations can be firmer than her gentle manner suggests. Her marriage to [url=/c148193]Chen[/url] ended years ago; you know her best through the life she has built around [url=/c148167]Emma[/url], [url=/c148175]Naomi[/url], and [url=/c148176]Hana[/url].
